visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a white shirt and grey overalls stands behind a blue ping pong table in a brightly lit indoor room. He holds a red paddle and covers his mouth with his hand, looking stressed. (2) Transition to a young woman with long reddish hair in a black sweatshirt, holding a paddle and preparing to hit the ball. The man misses the shot and looks shocked as mathematical graphics like 'E=mc2' float around his head. (3) The man applies a white facial mask to his face while looking upwards. Yellow sparkle and star graphics appear around him. He then appears radiant with a clean complexion, holding a red paddle. The woman watches him with pink heart graphics in her eyes. (4) The man stands holding two different packages of AKIMIA facial masks, one white and one blue, while smiling at the camera. (5) Scene shifts to an outdoor urban courtyard with grey concrete buildings. Two women sit on stone blocks, talking. A man in a blue polo shirt walks by in the background. (6) The two women compete to make exaggerated ugly faces. One woman applies a mask and suddenly looks beautiful and radiant. The man who walked by is shown looking shocked and then admiringly at her with heart graphics. (7) Scene shifts to an indoor office. A man in a black suit gestures aggressively, scolding a woman seated at a desk with a laptop. The woman applies the mask, and the boss's expression instantly changes to one of admiration and friendliness. (8) Close-up shots show hands pulling a physical tab on a facial mask package, allowing essence liquid to flow into the mask compartment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced male narration begins over a high-energy electronic pop track with a heavy kick drum beat. A sharp 'tock' sound of a ping-pong ball accompanies visual movements. (2) A sudden comedic 'whoosh' and a high-pitched 'sparkle' chime SFX trigger as the man expresses distress. (3) Sound of plastic rustling as a mask package is handled, followed by a 'ding' sound effect. (4) Transition to female voices speaking in a casual, conversational tone with birds chirping faintly in the background. (5) A resonant 'boing' cartoon SFX accompanies the ugly face reveal. (6) The magic sparkle SFX repeats loudly as the music shifts to a more triumphant, bright major key. (7) An aggressive, shouting male voice dominates the mix in a professional office setting, followed immediately by a comedic 'pop' sound and a shift to a flirtatious, soft vocal tone. (8) The final sequence features a rhythmic vocal slogan and a series of crisp 'click' and 'sliding' SFX representing the mask activation mechanism.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote AKIMIA micro-current facial masks by showing their 'instant' transformative effect in various social scenarios (sports, dating, workplace), framing the product as a way to 'recharge' one's beauty and charisma when facing embarrassment or pressure.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product, brand name mentioned in subtitles and slogan, and a detailed close-up demonstration of product use.
